raw_segments.text: I, for my part, was thoughtful too, for how best to check this growing change in Joe was
a great perplexity to my remorseful thoughts, that I was ashamed to tell him exactly how
I was placed and what I had come down to, I do not seek to conceal, but I hope my reluctance
was not quite an unworthy one.
He would want to help me out of his little savings, I knew, and I knew that he ought
not to help me, and that I must not suffer him to do it.
